title: Mandatory fuel price reporting, Servo Saver (Victoria)
summary: Regulations made on 5 August 2025 commenced on 6 August 2025: existing retailers had 14 business days to register and must report price changes within 30 minutes. The public Servo Saver service was announced on 15 October 2025.

instruments.title: Australian Consumer Law and Fair Trading (Code of Practice for Fuel Price Reporting) Regulations 2025

commenced.what: Regulations commenced: registration and price reporting
Servo Saver public price service announced

direction_rationale: Real-time public price data lower motorists' search costs, which should narrow retail margins, but they also let rival retailers see each other's prices at once, which can make tacit coordination and price cycles easier to sustain.
comparison: Staggered adoption 2016-2025. WA (FuelWatch, reporting since 2001) is always treated; the ACT has no mandatory scheme (a voluntary FuelCheck pilot from November 2022, not checked); states not yet reporting at each date.
confounders: crude oil and terminal gate price movements
temporary halving of fuel excise (30 Mar to 28 Sep 2022)

verified.notes: Read on the authorised regulations (Victorian register) and the Consumer Affairs Victoria notice.
